'''Paya''' is a traditional stew from [[South Asia]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vikatan.com/food/recipes/130561-sheep-leg-paya|title=Tamil Attukaal Paya (ஆட்டுக்கால் பாயா)|year=2017|publisher=Vikatan|language=ta|access-date=1 February 2020}}</ref> It is served at various festivals and gatherings, or made for special guests. ''Paya'' means 'leg'/'feet' in the [[Hindi]] and [[Urdu]] languages.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://dict.hinkhoj.com/पाया-meaning-in-english.words|title=पाया (Paya) meaning in English - पाया मीनिंग - Translation|year=2007|publisher=Hinkhoj|language=en|access-date=5 June 2018}}</ref> The main ingredients of the dish are the trotters ([[hooves]]) of a [[cow]], [[goat]], [[Water buffalo|buffalo]], or [[sheep]], cooked with various spices.
